Name: Jeshua, Son of Jozadak
Summary: High priest who returned with Zerubbabel, rebuilt the altar, and led the laying of the temple's foundation; his sons are later found among priests who had taken foreign wives.
KeyVerses: Ezra 2:2; Ezra 3:2; Ezra 3:8; Ezra 3:9; Ezra 4:3; Ezra 5:2; Ezra 10:18; Nehemiah 12:1
LifeLesson: Worship comes first: the altar was rebuilt before the walls.
RelatedEvents: Cyrus's Decree and Return from Exile; Rebuilding of the Temple; Nehemiah Rebuilds the Wall
